_doc: ATTACK_LOW_LR's windup (sword cocked low on the LEFT), committed ~30% into the sweep (captured.start), then a late, quick pull back to rest (captured.end). The recipe only has 3 keys (rest, windup, pull-back), so 'following the sweep' is done by aiming the windup at a pose 30% along the windup->slash-end line. In a chain the pull-back key is pinned at 1.0 s, so shorter t_back = pull back starts later. pull_back offsets only apply when captured.end is removed.

_help.like: uses this slash's windup (sword cocked low on the LEFT), then pulls back
_help.pull_back.lift: shoulder offset from the windup for the pull back (deg; negative = up/back)
_help.pull_back.wrist: wrist offset for the pull back (deg)
_help.t_back: seconds: the pull back (0.4 = as quick as the servo caps allow back to rest; the wrist roll has 90 deg to undo)
_help.captured.start: windup pose (real degrees): ATTACK_LOW_LR's windup moved 30% toward its slash end (pan -8 instead of -20), so the feint starts the sweep before pulling back. Delete to use the attack's exact windup.
_help.captured.end: end pose captured from the arm 2026-09-12 (real degrees): the rest pose (lift clamped from -89.7 to the -89 hard rule). Overrides pull_back. Delete the entry to go back to the computed pose.
